title: Operator access certification and SAML/KMS verification PRD + sign-off checklist
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Purpose: Define clear, testable acceptance criteria and a formal sign-off checklist for operator access certification, SAML federation verification, RBAC enforcement checks, and KMS/HSM proof artifacts for Private deployments. Scope: scoped to Private (VPC/on-prem) tenant onboarding flow and operator/admin onboarding for managed private control plane. Out-of-scope: full enterprise IAM contracts, IdP procurement, or organization-wide SSO governance beyond evidence handoff.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: SAML end-to-end: A sample tenant in staging completes SSO login (IdP->SP) with signed assertion captured; assertion fields (NameID, Audience, Recipient, NotOnOrAfter) are logged and stored in the audit stream for 30 days.

AC-2: RBAC enforcement: At least three RBAC policies (operator, admin, auditor) are exercised via automated test harness against a staging cluster and fail/allow behavior matches the policy matrix; violations must generate alert entries in the audit log and a matching incident in the test dashboard.

AC-3: KMS/HSM key access proof: Customer-managed key (CMK) operations (encrypt/decrypt, sign) are executed from an operator flow; every key operation produces an immutable audit record containing key_id, operation, caller_principal, timestamp, and a non-repudiable HSM signature where applicable.

AC-4: Delegated operator certification: Operational onboarding includes a checklist with required artifacts (SAML metadata, IdP contact, key rotation policy, emergency-escrow contacts). Each artifact must be present in the tenant onboarding bundle prior to granting operator role in production.

AC-5: Forensic retention and sampling: The audit retention policy for SAML/KMS/RBAC artifact samples is validated (30d default for staging, 365d for production), and a sampling query returns at least one signed assertion and one HSM-backed key operation for production-like load.

AC-6: Automated regression: CI job integrates acceptance tests; PRs that touch auth/crypto code block merge if any of the tests fail; test coverage threshold (end-to-end flows) >= 85% for the modules affected.
AC-7: Sign-off: Security, Platform Ops, and Legal each provide explicit sign-off strings in the checklist before the onboarding flow is marked complete for a tenant.

AC-8: Rollback trigger: If audit streaming to customer-owned S3 or SIEM fails for more than 5 minutes during onboarding, the operator grant is automatically revoked and a rollback runbook item executes.
success_metrics: Time-to-operator-grant <= 48 hours for standard tenants (post-artifact submission)
Zero unauthorized RBAC escalations in first 30 days for new tenants
Audit evidence completeness >= 99% (no missing fields in captured SAML/HSM logs)
Automated CI gate flakiness < 2% across 6 weeks after rollout

audit_steps: Step 1: Deploy tenant in staging with SAML federation configured (use test IdP) and enable audit streaming to test SIEM.
Step 2: Execute SSO login flow and capture the SAML assertion at the SP ingress point; push captured assertion as an opaque blob into the audit stream with metadata tags.
Step 3: Run RBAC test harness exercising operator/admin/auditor flows; ensure logs include policy decisions and reason codes.
Step 4: Perform KMS operations using customer CMK; verify HSM signature presence and log envelope integrity.
Step 5: Run retention verification: query sample assertions and key operations for configured windows and validate hashes against stored digests.
Step 6: Simulate audit pipeline failure and verify rollback trigger revokes operator grant and triggers incident channel.
test_plan: Automated e2e: CI job spins a transient staging tenant and runs AC-1..AC-6 tests; job reports artifacts to a test-bucket.
Manual: Security to perform random assertion forensics on 2 staging tenants and validate HSM-signed key ops.
Load: Run a 10k-user SSO sampling to validate audit pipeline throughput and buffer behavior.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): Run tests against two staging regions and iterate on schema (2 weeks).
Phase 2 (canary): Onboard 3 low-risk customers with full audit streaming to production SIEM; Security to monitor for 14 days.
Phase 3 (general): Gradual enablement with operator onboarding checklist enforced by automation; request final sign-offs from Security, Platform Ops, and Legal.
